messages:
nora: FYI opened a tiny PR to fix a couple of observability docs + add runnable snippets for the Console cost/latency page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
liam: Thanks. Which snippets did you add?
nora: Two small ones: `docs/snippets/sdk/node/console_cost_example.js` and `docs/snippets/sdk/py/console_cost_example.py`. Also updated `docs/console/dashboards/cost-latency.md` to reference them and fixed 1 broken link to `docs/metrics/series-expr.md`.
paul: Can you confirm the node snippet has the right import? we had broken CommonJS/ESM before.
nora: Node uses CommonJS in samples: `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')`. I added a comment explaining ESM users can `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'` instead.
tara: Please include a small offline-mode note for the python sample so CI won't try to hit network. Last time that caused flakes.
nora: Done. Python sample uses a fake client: `from redwood_sdk.testing import FakeClient` and a comment `# example is offline-only`
liam: On the dashboard page you added a short cost breakdown JSON. Are we explicit about defaulting missing fields?
nora: Yes, added this one-liner in the doc: `unit_cost = span.meta.get('unit_cost', 0)` and a small note recommending SLO panels treat missing cost as 0.
paul: I noticed the page used both "SLO" and "SLA". Can you standardize to "SLO"?
nora: Switched to SLO everywhere in the PR.
tara: Also minor UX ask: add hover text for the cost panel so Console shows a tooltip. Just a one-liner in the preset JSON.
nora: Added `description` to the preset with a 1-line tooltip text.
docs-bot: PR #523 updated: labels: docs, snippets  assigned to @nora
liam: I'll do a review pass for correctness. If it's small, we can merge and follow up with a CI smoke-check PR that executes the snippets.
paul: Agree. For the CI check, please make sure node invocation uses `node -e "require('./docs/snippets/sdk/node/console_cost_example.js')"` so require path resolves from repo root.
nora: Noted. I added a note in the PR description with the suggested CI command.
tara: One more tiny nit: the tracehook example shows `trace('span')` without attrs. Add an example with `attrs` including `token_count` and `token_cost` so users see mapping.
nora: Added a short example line: `redwood.trace('step', { attrs: { token_count: 42, token_cost: 0.005 } })`
liam: LGTM from my side. No large wording changes.
paul: LGTM infra. Merging after CI smoke-check PR is queued.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs owners ping at 1756668600
tara: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround.
